name: ROOTS
subtitle: Culture, colour & belonging.
desc: A culture magazine built around expressive portraiture, warm illustration and a strong editorial voice.
approach: Layered cover lines introduce the issue. Inside, text follows the contours of illustration, while asymmetrical image placement gives each feature its own pace.
details: Editorial hierarchy / Contour text wrap / Illustration-led layouts

name: Coast & Trail
subtitle: Room to explore.
desc: A travel brochure that lets the landscape lead, pairing expansive photography with a calm, readable information structure.
approach: Large scenic images establish the destination. Smaller supporting details and carefully spaced typography create a natural rhythm between inspiration and practical information.
details: Travel brochure / Landscape photography / Page rhythm

name: Daily Ritual
subtitle: A quieter kind of beauty.
desc: A beauty catalog with soft colour, focused product imagery and a consistent hierarchy for product information.
approach: Oval image framing and restrained lavender tones give the collection a recognisable identity. Clear product names, descriptions and specifications keep the pages easy to browse.
details: Product hierarchy / Beauty catalog / Soft geometric framing

name: SUNPOP
subtitle: A little crunch. A brighter break.
desc: An energetic snack catalog that gives the product range a bright, distinct personality.
approach: Individually angled packs sit against organic colour fields. Ingredient cutouts, a coconut splash and a subtle leaf pattern bring movement to the pages without competing with the product information.
details: Product cutouts / Organic shapes / Ingredient-led composition

name: Willow & Vale
subtitle: Your day, naturally.
desc: A wedding venue brochure with a botanical visual language and photography that carries the atmosphere of the setting.
approach: Irregular photo masks soften the image boundaries. Delicate botanical outlines and overlapping caption cards connect the pages, balanced with generous spacing and elegant serif headings.
details: Venue brochure / Botanical linework / Irregular image masks

name: SHIFT
subtitle: A different perspective.
desc: A design and culture magazine with a bold graphic identity: monochrome photography, electric yellow and direct typography.
approach: High-contrast colour blocks act as anchors around architectural images and portraits. Changing image scales and offset compositions create a deliberate, energetic reading experience.
details: Graphic editorial / High contrast / Asymmetric composition

name: Northline
subtitle: Clarity in the detail.
desc: A business report designed to make performance figures, narrative and priorities easy to scan.
approach: A restrained black-and-orange palette separates headlines from supporting information. Consistent number styling, charts and page structure help readers move between the overview and the detail.
details: Business report / Information hierarchy / Chart styling

name: Form & Field
subtitle: Rooms to live in.
desc: A furniture catalog combining natural textures, warm photography and precise product information.
approach: Alternating full-room photography and individual product features gives the collection room to breathe. Material swatches and a specification table add practical detail without disturbing the visual rhythm.
details: Furniture catalog / Material palettes / Product specifications

name: Kora
subtitle: Better materials. Built into tomorrow.
desc: A company profile for a circular-materials identity, connecting brand narrative with services, process and applications.
approach: Circular material imagery introduces the visual identity. Numbered service sections, an application story and a clear process sequence guide the reader from the company overview to the practical details.
details: Company profile / Circular image framing / Process diagrams

name: TABLE
subtitle: The Slow Sunday Issue.
desc: A food and culture magazine with warm editorial photography, readable essays and a distinctive recipe layout.
approach: Large food photographs punctuate the issue, while two-column essays and an offset ingredient panel establish a varied reading rhythm. Red serif headlines carry the editorial identity across market stories, recipes and hosting notes.
details: Food editorial / Recipe layout / Long-form typography

name: SIGNAL Studio
subtitle: A clear start makes better work possible.
desc: A client welcome guide that turns project preparation, file handover and review into a clear sequence.
approach: Editable phone interface diagrams, short annotated steps and compact checklists organise the information. The restrained blue-grey palette and consistent icon system keep the instructions easy to scan.
details: Client onboarding / Interface diagrams / Instructional hierarchy
